name: tiling-layout-plan-g5
description: v0.31.5.288 visual verification: the new Tiling layout plan sheet. Sets 600x600 porcelain on several rooms of the default flat, opens the drawing set, and captures the sheet — the tile grid struck from the computed origin, the perimeter cut bands tinted, the origin cross, and the per-room module/cut note.

steps.name: tile-several-rooms
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const ids=Object.keys(s.finishes.floor||{}); if(!ids.length) throw new Error('no floor finishes in the store'); window.__tiled=[]; for (const id of ids) { s.setFloorFinish(id, 'floor-tile-white'); s.setWallFinish ? s.setWallFinish(id, 'wall-tile-white') : s.setWallColor?.(id, 'wall-tile-white'); window.__tiled.push(id); } })()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml=null; window.open=function(){ return { document:{ write:function(html){ window.__capturedHtml=html }, close:function(){} }, close:function(){}, focus:function(){}, print:function(){} }; };

steps.name: click-drawing-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b=>/Drawing set/.test(b.textContent||'')); if(!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-sheet-content
steps.eval: (function(){ const h=window.__capturedHtml; if(!/Tiling layout plan/.test(h)) throw new Error('no Tiling layout plan sheet in the set'); if(!/class="origin"/.test(h)) throw new Error('sheet has no setting-out origin marker'); if(!/class="grid"/.test(h)) throw new Error('sheet has no tile grid — the module data did not reach it'); if(!/600×600/.test(h)) throw new Error('no module note on the sheet'); })()

steps.name: scroll-to-tiling-sheet
steps.eval: (function(){ const tb=[...document.querySelectorAll('.title-block')].find(e=>/Tiling layout plan/.test(e.textContent||'')); if(!tb) throw new Error('no Tiling layout plan title block'); const sheet=tb.parentElement; const svg=sheet?.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg) throw new Error('the tiling sheet has no svg'); svg.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()

steps.name: assert-elevation-course-grid
steps.eval: (function(){ const tb=[...document.querySelectorAll('.title-block')].find(e=>/^Wall /.test((e.querySelector('.tb-name')?.textContent||'').trim())); if(!tb) throw new Error('no wall-elevation sheet found'); const withGrid=[...document.querySelectorAll('.title-block')].map(t=>t.parentElement).find(sh=>sh && /tile-courses/.test(sh.innerHTML)); if(!withGrid) throw new Error('no elevation sheet carries a tile-courses overlay — the wall coursing did not reach elevationSvg'); const svg=withGrid.querySelector('svg'); svg.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()
